cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: People.

words.en: Tom is not an adult yet.
words.sz: Tom 还不是一个成年人。
words.scene: Tom standing on a stool trying to reach the top shelf, while Dad stands next to him easily reaching it himself.
more: Adults drink coffee in the morning.
This is an adult swimming pool.

words.en: Mia's big sister has a new boyfriend.
words.sz: Mia 的姐姐交了个新男朋友。
words.scene: A smiling young woman and her boyfriend holding hands in a sunny park.
more: Uncle Ben was Aunt Kate's boyfriend before they got married.
Ben 叔叔和 Kate 阿姨结婚前是她的男朋友。

words.en: Mia's big brother has a girlfriend.
words.sz: Mia 的哥哥有女朋友了。
words.scene: A young man giving a bunch of flowers to his smiling girlfriend in a park.
more: Aunt Kate was Uncle Ben's girlfriend before they got married.
Kate 阿姨和 Ben 叔叔结婚前是他的女朋友。

words.en: The man in the suit is a business person.
words.sz: 那个穿西装的男人是个商人。
words.scene: A grown-up woman in her forties in a dark suit with a briefcase, shaking hands with a grown-up man in a suit in a modern office lobby, a big glass window behind them.
more: Many business people work in London.
She wants to be a business person.

words.en: Lily sees a celebrity at the cinema.
words.sz: Lily 在电影院看到一位名人。
words.scene: A famous singer wearing sunglasses and a hat, surrounded by fans holding cameras outside a cinema.
more: This actor is a big celebrity.
The celebrity writes names for fans.

words.sz: Max 是我最喜欢的角色。
words.scene: A puppet show with a funny dog puppet (Max) as the main character on stage.
more: The story has many interesting characters.
这个故事有很多有趣的角色。

words.sz: 小丑逗得 Tom 大笑。
words.scene: A colourful clown with a red nose and big shoes juggling balls in a circus ring, looking at the audience.
more: I saw a funny clown today.
我今天看到了一个有趣的小丑。
The clown wears a red hat.

words.sz: 妈妈有一位善良的同事。
words.scene: Mum in her nurse uniform talking and laughing with another nurse in the hospital corridor.
more: Dad eats lunch with his colleagues.
爸爸和同事一起吃午饭。
妈妈的同事来拜访我们。

words.en: There is a big crowd at the park.
words.scene: Many people standing close together watching a street performance in a busy square.

words.en: Tom is a big fan of Max.
words.sz: Tom 是 Max 的超级粉丝。
words.scene: Tom holding up a sign with a drawing of the puppy Max on it, looking excited at a pet show.
more: The fans sing for their team.
球迷们为他们的球队唱歌。

words.scene: A friendly woman standing at the school gate waving to children, wearing a blazer with a school badge.
more: The headteacher speaks in the hall.
Lily says hello to the headteacher.

words.scene: An elderly woman (Grandma) in an apron baking cookies in a cozy kitchen, flour on the table.
more: My friend's mum is a housewife.
我朋友的妈妈是家庭主妇。
A housewife works hard at home.
家庭主妇在家里很辛苦。

words.en: The kid plays with a ball.
words.scene: A young child (Tom) sitting on the grass playing with a red ball.
more: Are you a good kid, Tom?
Many kids go to school today.

words.scene: A tall man in a blue shirt opening a front door to let people in.
A woman in a uniform sitting in the driver's seat of a red double-decker bus, holding the steering wheel.
more: 那位女士买了一些牛奶。

words.sz: 在美国，人们叫妈妈为 Mom。
more: American children say Mom, not Mum.
美国孩子说 Mom，不说 Mum。
Mom is short for mother in America.
在美国，Mom 是母亲的简称。

words.en: Lily and Mia are dance partners.
words.sz: Lily 和 Mia 是舞伴。
words.scene: Two girls dancing together in a bright room, holding hands and smiling.
more: Tom needs a partner for the game.
Tom 需要一个搭档来玩游戏。
Dad is my tennis partner today.
今天爸爸是我的网球搭档。

words.en: Many people are at the park.
words.scene: A busy park scene with many different people walking, sitting on benches, and playing.
more: People love ice cream in summer.
夏天人们喜欢吃冰淇淋。
The train is full of people.

words.scene: A single friendly man waving hello, standing clearly apart from others.
more: Who is that person at the door?

words.sz: Lily 是一个快乐的小学生。
words.scene: A girl wearing a school uniform and carrying a backpack, walking towards a school building.
more: 每个小学生都需要一支钢笔。
Tom is not a schoolchild yet.
Tom 还不是一个小学生。

words.sz: 那位女士是一名科学家。
words.scene: A man in a white lab coat looking into a microscope in a laboratory.
more: Lily wants to be a scientist.
Lily 想成为一名科学家。

words.scene: A boy running on a track, wearing sports clothes and running shoes.
more: 爸爸是一个很好的跑步者。
The young runner won the race.
那个年轻的赛跑运动员赢得了比赛。

words.en: The movie star is in the film.
words.sz: 这位电影明星在电影里。
words.scene: A glamorous person waving to a crowd, with cameras and lights in front.
more: Mia 喜欢那位电影明星。
The movie star has many fans.
这位电影明星有很多粉丝。

words.en: The music comes from the speaker.
words.scene: A black rectangular speaker box with sound waves coming out of it.
more: 请把扬声器的声音调大一点。
The big speaker is in the hall.
大厅里有一个大扬声器。

words.scene: A tall police officer, a grown-up man about forty years old with a short grey beard, in a dark blue uniform and police hat, standing beside a blue and yellow checked police car, a grown-up woman officer with him.
more: Call the police if you are lost.
The police have a big dog.

words.scene: An old man with a thick, soft grey beard around his chin and cheeks.

words.en: Tom is six years of age.
words.scene: A birthday cake with candles showing the number six, a boy looking at it happily.
more: Grandma has a young heart for her age.
奶奶虽然年纪大了，但心态很年轻。

words.scene: An old, grey-haired cat sleeping peacefully on a cushion.
A baby wrapped in a blanket, with flowers blooming outside the window indicating spring.
more: The birth of a baby is happy news.
The panda's birth is happy news.
熊猫的出生是个好消息。

words.scene: A newborn baby asleep in a small bed, Mum smiling down at it.
more: Max was born in the garden.
Max 是在花园里出生的。

words.scene: Children playing and learning in a bright, colorful classroom.
more: The flower has a short life.
我们热爱我们的家庭生活。

words.scene: Lily shaking hands with a new girl at school, both smiling and telling each other their names.

more: Dad writes his nationality on the form.
爸爸在表格上填写国籍。

words.en: Dad shows his ID to the man.
words.sz: 爸爸向那个人出示了他的身份证件。
words.scene: A grown-up man in a blue jumper showing a small plastic card with a photo of his face to a woman behind a reception desk, the card blank apart from the photo.
more: You need ID to buy the ticket.

words.sz: 妈妈弄丢了她的身份证。
words.scene: One small plastic card lying on a wooden table next to a bunch of keys; on the card a tiny photo of a dark-haired woman about thirty-five years old; the rest of the card plain and blank.
more: Show me your ID card, please.
The ID card has his name on it.

words.sz: 那个人要求出示身份证明。
more: She shows her identification to the police.
她向警察出示她的身份证明。

words.en: Tom wants to grow up fast.
words.scene: Tom standing against a door frame with marks showing his height, looking up at Mum who is smiling.
more: I will grow up to be tall.

words.en: Mia's sister will get married in June.
words.sz: Mia 的姐姐六月要结婚了。
words.scene: A wedding cake with two figures on top, white flowers around it, and a ring box nearby.
more: They want to get married next year.

words.scene: Dad jogging in a park wearing sportswear, sweating slightly, looking energetic.

words.en: Mum has a career in nursing.
words.scene: Mum wearing her nurse uniform, holding a clipboard, standing in a hospital corridor.
more: Dad loves his career in the office.
爸爸喜欢他在办公室的职业。
She chose a career in teaching.
她选择了教书这个职业。

words.en: The show was a big success.
words.scene: Lily on stage taking a bow, with flowers and clapping hands in the foreground.
more: The party was a great success.

words.scene: Lily looking at an old photo album, smiling as she remembers a happy day.
more: Grandma has a bad memory today.
He has strong feelings for Max.
他对 Max 有强烈的感情。

words.scene: A close-up of a child's foot, one big toe wrapped in a small white bandage.
Tom opening his mouth wide for the dentist to check, sitting in a chair.
more: Max has a ball in his mouth.
Don't talk with your mouth full.

words.scene: Mum sitting on the sofa, holding her head with both hands, looking tired and resting.
more: The noise gives me a headache.
